description: BillPay Guard: an autonomous bill-payment agent with spending limits enforced on-chain, on the QoreChain testnet (qorechain-diana). Every payment is an EVM transaction admitted only inside a post-quantum authorisation window, and the guard contract enforces per-payment caps, total caps, payment counts, intervals, expiry, and an allowlisted payee.
name: billpay-guard

scripts.compile: npx solc@0.8.24 --optimize --abi --bin -o out contracts/BillPayGuard.sol && node scripts/build-artifact.mjs
